SDK latest develop commit is 2024-10-15, repository pushed_at 2025-07-16 is not a code-change date.

Sourcify reports creation/runtime match, not exact_match, for both routers: metadata-relaxed matching with recorded immutable and CBOR replacements. Complete deployment-specific source and ABI are retained; no generic fork ABI was substituted.

All token quantities are integer token base units, LP quantities LP base units, native amounts wei and deadlines Unix seconds. Caller-selected recipients receive LP/output; native exact-output/add-liquidity excess refunds go to msg.sender. Preexisting token/LP allowance is required; this inventory grants no approvals or permits.

Factory-derived pools and external tokens/WETH are dependencies; pair fees are read dynamically in basis points using denominator10000. Exact-input output rounds down and exact-output input rounds up. Dependency safety, present pool existence/liquidity and token behavior are not attested.

Fixed factory-derived path swap, caller-selected to, enforced deadline; no arbitrary target/calldata executor. Exact-output bounds caller input by amountInMax or msg.value and rounds required input up. Pulls path[0] from msg.sender directly to first pair; zero native value. Does not account for transfer-tax tokens; exact-output has no tax-support variant.

What is Swapr?

Swapr is a multi-chain AMM with a suite of unique features including LP governance, DIY farming, and much more. Swapr is the first automated market maker (AMM) to allow for adjustable swap fees through governance and has been organically developed within the DXdao community. Swapr marks the first time a DAO has launched a DeFi protocol on Ethereum.

Products

DXdao owns and operates DeFI products and protocols on Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Gnosis Chain. DXdaoâs current suite of products include:

Swapr

A multi-chain AMM with a suite of unique features including LP governance, DIY farming, and much more.

You can visit the Swapr Dapp here or learn more about Swapr here.

Carrot

A community-driven programmable incentives platform designed to distribute rewards when set criteia have been met.

You can visit the Carrot Dapp here or learn more about Carrot here.

DXgov

DXgov is the squad responsible for and umbrella term for all our governance products. This includes the internal development of our own DAO as well as external facing products to serve and govern other DAOs.

You can learn more about DXgov here.

Omen

A fully decentralized multi-chain prediction market platform.

You can visit the Omen Dapp here or learn more about Omen here.

Aqua

A fair auction IDO launchpad.

You can visit the Aqua Dapp here or learn more about Aqua here.

Mesa

A permissionless DEX that enables ring trades to maximize liquidity

You can visit the Mesa V1 Dapp here or learn more about Mesa here.

Other

Do you have an interesting idea for a potential new DXdao product? Are you a project looking to be incubated? Start a conversation on the DXdao Discord, and make a proposal on DAOtalk!

warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only: not persistent runtime attestation, live authorization, liquidity, backing, financial safety, execution success or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Only Swapr own V2 DXswapRouter deployments on Ethereum and Arbitrum; not Swaprum, Swapr Gnosis V3, ecosystem aggregator, bridge or third-party routing. Factory and wrapped-native addresses are immutable; pairs are derived from that factory and fixed init-code hash, and callbacks receive empty bytes.

Primary DXdao product pages and currently served Swapr frontend retain V2 product links; pinned own SDK explicitly supports MAINNET and ARBITRUM_ONE V2. No explicit sunset, team-disbandment or V2 deprecation notice was found in reviewed primary pages; this is not a promise of future development. SDK latest develop commit is 2024-10-15, repository pushed_at 2025-07-16 is not a code-change date.

Sourcify reports creation/runtime match, not exact_match, for both routers: metadata-relaxed matching with recorded immutable and CBOR replacements. Complete deployment-specific source and ABI are retained; no generic fork ABI was substituted.

All token quantities are integer token base units, LP quantities LP base units, native amounts wei and deadlines Unix seconds. Caller-selected recipients receive LP/output; native exact-output/add-liquidity excess refunds go to msg.sender. Preexisting token/LP allowance is required; this inventory grants no approvals or permits.

Factory-derived pools and external tokens/WETH are dependencies; pair fees are read dynamically in basis points using denominator10000. Exact-input output rounds down and exact-output input rounds up. Dependency safety, present pool existence/liquidity and token behavior are not attested.

Pulls optimized tokenA/tokenB amounts from msg.sender directly to the factory-derived pair, creates pair if absent and mints LP to to. Existing reserve branch checks minimum only on optimized side; fresh zero-reserve pair accepts both desired amounts without separate minimum checks. No native value.
